profile.name: Ilias Thalassochoritis
profile.headline: Full Stack Engineer
profile.intro: I build reliable web products and take them from the first idea to production.
profile.professional_summary: My main tools are TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, and FastAPI. I care about clear architecture, fast products, and infrastructure that stays reliable as projects grow.
profile.seo_description: Full Stack Engineer building scalable SaaS platforms and high-performance web applications.

certifications.title: AI Applications & Data Security
certifications.description: I hold a professional certification in AI Applications & Data Security. It helps me build practical, compliance-aware tools and improve business workflows.

education.title: Graduated in Computer Engineering
education.summary: I graduated in Computer Engineering from the University of Thessaly and have been building scalable web applications ever since.
education.description: Thesis: Siamese Neural Networks for Image Similarity (VGG19). Developed a web application for real-time image analysis with interactive mapping.

employment.title: Full Stack Web Engineer - VODA.ai
employment.description: I build full-stack systems for VODA.ai's AI-powered water infrastructure platform. I work on predictive analytics and decision-support tools that help utilities understand risk, monitor leaks, and plan investments. My stack includes Express.js, React, Redux, TypeScript, JavaScript, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, AWS, and Go.

employment.title: Software Engineer & Architect (PharmaFinder)
employment.description: I led the v2 architectural rewrite and helped move the platform to Next.js 16 with Server Actions. I also built a high-performance geospatial search engine with advanced caching.

employment.title: Lead Full Stack Engineer - Wizy
employment.description: I led delivery across three production platforms, working directly with the CEO, project managers, and government vendors. I architected WizyHRM's physical data isolation and automated provisioning, helped deliver the Digital School admin portal for gov.gr, and built the VAT engine for the ELOT E-shop.

employment.title: Software Engineer (Product & R&D)
employment.description: I worked across the full lifecycle of proprietary data products. I designed and shipped E-food Analytics for large-scale data visualization, built PharmaFinder's first geospatial search, and refactored legacy systems around Feature-Sliced Design.

employment.title: Software Engineer - Hellenic Army IT Corps
employment.description: I modernized the official Hellenic Army website, which served more than 550k monthly visitors with near-100% uptime in an ISO 27001-compliant environment. I also wrote Python automation scripts for a large data migration, cutting manual content entry time by 80%.

employment.title: Full Stack Web Developer (Internship) - Crowdpolicy
employment.description: I built front-end features and custom PHP themes for fintech and gov-tech projects. This was my first experience in an Agile team, with daily stand-ups and sprint planning.

projects.title: WizyHRM
projects.description: An enterprise SaaS platform built around physical data isolation. It provisions infrastructure, databases, and DNS records at runtime with Trigger.dev and Cloudflare. It also handles Greek labor-law rules and dependency-aware subscriptions.

projects.title: Digital School (gov.gr)
projects.description: The official streaming back office for the Ministry of Education. It supports live lectures with HLS.js and low-latency buffering, with OIDC authentication and role-based access for admins and streamers.

projects.title: ELOT E-shop
projects.description: An e-commerce platform for the Hellenic Organization for Standardization. I built its VAT engine for B2B, B2C, and intra-community sales, connected the shop to Pylon ERP, and added instant search across thousands of standards with MeiliSearch.

projects.title: PharmaFinder
projects.description: A pharmacy discovery platform designed for fast map searches. It reached a 99/100 Lighthouse Performance score through ISR, radius-based caching, and hybrid clustering, and meets WCAG 2.1 accessibility requirements.

projects.title: VaporKey
projects.description: A secure service for sharing short-lived secrets. Redis expiration events delete secrets automatically, while its zero-knowledge design keeps stored values inaccessible to the service. It runs in Docker on DigitalOcean.

interests.description: Away from code, I enjoy experimenting with IoT hardware, running home servers, and taking photos.
